name: gccli
title_zh: 终端里直接管 Google 日历，不离开键盘
tagline_zh: 开会前才想起没看日程？在终端敲两下就能查空闲、建事件、改时间，不用切窗口、不用点鼠标，比开网页快三秒。
tagline_en: Scheduling without leaving your terminal. Check availability, create events, and edit—faster than opening the.
desc_en: Google Calendar CLI for listing calendars, viewing/creating/updating events, and checking availability.
why_zh: 它把日历操作压成 CLI 命令，能直接嵌进脚本和快捷键流。查空闲、建事件、改时间一气呵成，适合键盘党。
why_en: Turns calendar ops into composable CLI commands, so you can script them or bind to hotkeys. No GUI, no friction.
limit_zh: 只认 Google 日历，需要本机配好 OAuth 凭据；不支持 Exchange/Outlook。只覆盖日历读写。
limit_en: Google Calendar only; requires local OAuth setup. No Exchange/Outlook. Handles events/availability only—no reminders, attachments, or Meet links.
